title: Hello Precession
vysu:
# title: Hello Precession
# version: 1
# featured: true
# group: Precession
# tags: intro, precession, seasonal-frame
# order: 10
# Visualize axial precession against the fixed nakshatra sky
stage blank night year -2800
camera pos -147.464,73.504,234.757 target 0,0,0

seq 1000 
caption "Visualize Precession" 1200:250:350

at 2000 {
	show eclipticGrid ; 
	show eclipticNakSegments
	fade stars
	rollout naks
	show seasonalFrame
	show poleTrack
	show overlay
	show thuban
	show polaris
	caption "2800 BCE" 1000:200:300
	travel -2800 to 2100 15000: step 100
	wait 8000
	camera pos -0,286.809,0 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
	wait 8000
	camera pos -147.464,73.504,234.757 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
}

title: Precession Explorer
vysu:
# title   : Precession Explorer  
# version : 1
# featured: true
# group   : Precession
# tags    : intro, precession, seasonal-frame
# order   : 10
# Visualize axial precession and seasonal naks against the fixed nakshatra sky

seq 1000   # main sequence start


at 0 {
    # blank stage at -4000 BCE
    stage blank year -4000
    show overlay

    camera pos -86.895,77.787,262.026 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    grid equatorial 10   # show equatorial grid

    style nsAxis color yellow
    show nsAxis   # show north-south axis

    camera pos -16.157,280.502,57.591 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900

    style precessionCircle color yellow
    show precessionCircle   # show precession circle path

    seq 2000
    show sisumara
    show thuban
    show matsya
    show polaris
    show NP   # show pole markers

    travel -4000 to -2800 3000: step 100
    #camera pos -10.64,184.717,37.925 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
     camera pos -0.306,262.855,1.306 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
      label tNp "2800 BCE - Abhaya Dhruva/Thuban is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
     style thuban lbl(10 gold 50%) 
     flash thuban
     style thuban lbl(5 gold 100%) 
}


+3000 {
    # transition to Polaris era
    clear label tNp

    camera pos -16.157,280.502,57.591 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    travel -2800 to 2100 6000: step 100
    wait 4000
    camera pos -0.306,262.855,1.306 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    label pNp "2100 CE - Matsya Dhruva/Polaris is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
     style polaris lbl(10 gold 50%) 
     flash polaris
     style polaris lbl(5 gold 100%) 
}


+4000 {
    # clear Polaris label and adjust camera
    clear label pNp
    camera pos -167.086,194.865,143.526 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
}


+1000 {
    # show nakshatra and ecliptic labels
    camera pos -34.897,173.674,234.754 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900

    show *nak
    show $nak
    show @naks

    #show nakshatralabels 
    flash nakshatralabels

    show eclipticSegments
    flash eclipticLabels

    flash equator
    show equator

    flash NP
    show NP 

    show equatorialPlane 
    stage year -4000
    camera pos 6.327,47.448,290.17 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
}


+2000 {
    # flash seasonal markers again
    flash VE, SS, AE, WS
    show VE, SS, AE, WS
}

+2000 {
    # repeat initial setup for emphasis
    camera pos -0.131,293.589,0.405 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900

    hide equator 
    hide equatorialPlane
    flash eclipticLabels

     style naks lbl(30%)
     style eclipticSegments lbl(8 70%)
     style AE, SS, WS, VE  lbl(14 100%)
     flash VE, SS, AE, WS
}

+2000 {
    travel -4000 to -2800 3000: step 100
    # camera pos -10.64,184.717,37.925 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    label  lblx "2800 BCE - Abhaya Dhruva/Thuban is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
    flash thuban
}

+2000 {
     label clear lblx
    travel -2800 to -1800 2000: step 100
    label lblx "1800 BCE - Maghadi Era - Magha and SS" color gold size 1.3
#    flash @magha 1000:
    flash @mag , sector.mag 1000:
    flash SS 1000:
}

+4000 {
     label clear lblx
    travel -1800 to 2100 4000: step 100
     wait 2000
    # camera pos -10.64,184.717,37.925 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    label lblx "2100 CE - Matsya Dhruva/Polaris  is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
    flash polaris
}

title: Tour of Nakshatras
Top View of Precession
vysu:
# title: Top View of Precession
# version: 1
# featured: false
# group: Precession
# tags: pole-track, top-view, thuban, polaris
# order: 30
# Top-down review of precession against the fixed nakshatra ring.
stage blank night year -3000
camera pos 0,325,0.1 target 0,0,0 fov 42
show eclipticNakSegments ; show eclipticPoles ; show stars ; show naks
show northPolarItems ; hide southPolarItems
show poleTrack ; show seasonalFrame ; show overlay
caption "Precession from above the ecliptic pole" 1600:300:450
flash precessionCircle 1500:
caption "The pole marker approaches Thuban around 2300 BCE" 2100:350:500
travel -3000 to 2000 9000: step 100
caption "Polaris becomes the north-pole marker near 1900 CE" 2200:350:500

cues.text: Precession from above the ecliptic pole
The pole marker approaches Thuban around 2300 BCE
Polaris becomes the north-pole marker near 1900 CE
